# Test and demo fixture provenance

The project license in the repository root applies to RustSMF-authored code.
It does not grant rights to assets whose author or license is unknown. These
fixtures are test inputs unless individually identified below; their test-only
provenance does not imply permission to redistribute them as product samples.

## Identified RustSMF-authored fixtures

- `invalid-model.gml` is a small invalid-input fixture kept for RustSMF error
  handling tests.
- `independent-fbx/independent_skinned.fbx` and
  `independent-fbx/independent_skinned_texture.png` are generated by the
  adjacent `generate_fixture.py` using Blender 5.0.0. The generation script
  creates the mesh, rig, animation, and 4-by-4 texture; it does not use an
  external model, image, or exporter asset. See
  [`docs/dev/fixtures/INDEPENDENT_FBX_PROVENANCE.md`](../../../../docs/dev/fixtures/INDEPENDENT_FBX_PROVENANCE.md)
  for the fixture contract and regeneration command.
- `external-gltf/scene.gltf` is a RustSMF-authored test scene. Its referenced
  `mesh.bin` payload is the nine ASCII bytes `012345678`; the test asserts its
  SHA-256. The files are committed test dependencies as documented in
  `source/frontend/tests/README.md`.
- In-memory fixtures produced by `source/frontend/tests/helpers/` and the
  external-FBX helper are generated by RustSMF test code. They do not import
  an external model or image.

`helpers/interchange-fixtures.ts` authors triangle OBJ/MTL/DAE/GLTF data, known
translation keys and a decoded 2x2 PNG in memory. Extended skinned fixtures
create unnamed helper groups, one-frame reference clips and boundary-size rigs
without external geometry, textures, rig data or motion.

## Unresolved asset provenance

The source or license for `external-gltf/texture.png` has not been identified
in the available repository records. Do not treat the root MIT license as a
grant for this image or redistribute it beyond the existing test context until
its provenance is recorded. This document does not claim it is third-party or
first-party.

If a future fixture incorporates any outside model, image, animation, or other
asset, record its creator/source, exact version or URL, applicable license and
required notice beside the fixture before redistribution. Do not infer a grant
from a filename, format, or repository presence.

## Signal Robot quickstart

The root examples/rustsmf-demo.glb is generated solely from project-owned boxes, skin influences, materials and motion in src/utils/previewDemo.ts using scripts/generate-preview-demo.ts. It has no external model/image input. The root MIT license covers it; examples/README.md describes regeneration.

## Browser sidecar rendering case

ZIP tests construct in-memory archives with Three.js's vendored fflate writer, reusing project-authored model generators and a freshly encoded two-by-two PNG. The unknown-provenance image and private donor/Tripo assets are not included. No generated ZIP or model is committed.

The external GLTF browser rendering case creates a non-collinear Float32 triangle, UVs and an encoded two-by-two PNG in memory. It reuses the authored scene structure while leaving the fixed nine-byte mesh.bin file and its native IPC/hash contract untouched. That byte-only fixture is not accepted as visible geometry proof.

## Sable original animation pack

`examples/black-cat/` contains an original image-guided Tripo Pro design, repaired
in Blender 5.2.1 LTS with original rig/weights and Idle/Walk/Run/Sit keys. The
finished pack is MIT licensed, copyright 2026 Shoozes. Generation-specific paid
rights evidence belongs to `docs/dev/ASSET_PROVENANCE.md`; `asset.json` binds the
source/output hashes and geometry/clip contracts. The rejected procedural model,
raw Tripo drafts and borrowed fox reference stay private and are not test inputs.
